vm._note: The hypervisor of the virtual machines module. list prints one <name><TAB>running|stopped per machine and fails when the hypervisor does not answer; configure tells it about the <pool>/vm dataset. definition_template, disk_template and nic_template turn the neutral machine record into the backend's definition. Every edition gives a machine the same hardware: UEFI, virtio disks and networks in the same PCI slots, plain VGA and one serial port. access_group is the system group whose members may use the hypervisor's own tools; empty when there is none.
vm.list: out=$(LC_ALL=C virsh -c qemu:///system list --all) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk 'NR>2 && NF {{ print $2 "\t" ($3 == "running" ? "running" : "stopped") }}'
vm.definition_template:
<domain type='kvm'>
  <name>{name}</name>
  <uuid>{uuid}</uuid>
  <memory unit='MiB'>{memory_mb}</memory>
  <vcpu>{cpus}</vcpu>
  <cpu mode='host-passthrough'/>
  <os firmware='efi'>
    <type arch='x86_64' machine='pc'>hvm</type>
  </os>
  <features>
    <acpi/>
    <apic/>
  </features>
  <devices>
{cdrom}{disks}{nics}    <controller type='usb' model='qemu-xhci'/>
    <input type='tablet' bus='usb'/>
    <serial type='pty'/>
    <console type='pty'/>
    <graphics type='vnc' autoport='yes' listen='127.0.0.1'/>
    <video>
      <model type='vga'/>
    </video>
    <memballoon model='none'/>
  </devices>
</domain>
vm.disk_template:
<disk type='block' device='disk'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='raw' cache='none' io='native'/>
      <source dev='/dev/zvol/{zvol}'/>
      <target dev='vd{letter}' bus='virtio'/>
      <boot order='{boot}'/>
      <address type='pci' domain='0x0000' bus='0x00' slot='{slot:#04x}' function='0x0'/>
    </disk>
vm.nic_template:
<interface type='bridge'>
      <mac address='{mac}'/>
      <source bridge='{bridge}'/>
      <model type='virtio'/>
      <address type='pci' domain='0x0000' bus='0x00' slot='{slot:#04x}' function='0x0'/>
    </interface>
vm.cdrom_template:
<disk type='file' device='cdrom'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='raw'/>
      <source file='{path}'/>
      <target dev='hda' bus='ide'/>
      <readonly/>
      <boot order='1'/>
    </disk>
